For our client in Beernem, we are looking for an experienced tiler.
 

You will join a young and dynamic team.
 

Be sure to apply if you are interested!
 

 
 

 

 
 

 
• You are a worker with several years of experience in tiling
 
• A driving licence is required!
 
• You speak fluent Dutch or English
 
• You have a VCA certificate or are willing to obtain one

Are you a night owl with a talent for solving technical challenges?

Do you thrive in a modern production environment where teamwork and quality are top priorities? Then this is the opportunity for you!

Your role

As a Maintenance Technician in the fixed night shift, you are essential to our production process. You ensure that machines operate at their best, perform preventive maintenance, and resolve malfunctions quickly and effectively. With your technical skills and problem-solving mindset, you keep the production running even while the world sleeps.

What will you do?

• Carry out preventive and corrective maintenance on machines and installations.

• Detect, analyze, and fix malfunctions (primarily electrical, ideally with mechanical expertise).

• Start up and optimize production lines.

• Actively contribute to improving the reliability and efficiency of the equipment.

• Collaborate with a team and report to the technical service manager.

Work schedule

• 2 workdays (2 x 7.36 hours) and 2 weekend days (2 x 11 hours), offering a steady yet varied schedule.

 

 

• A technical degree or relevant experience in a production environment.

• Broad technical knowledge of mechanics, electricity, and pneumatics; PLC knowledge is a plus.

• A flexible, positive attitude and strong problem-solving skills.

• A team player who is eager to learn and improve.

• Fluency in Dutch or English.

jobs.description:
Vacature: Surveyor Liquid Cargo Antwerpen en Gent
 

Bureau Veritas Commodities is een grote speler op gebied van controles van logistieke operaties, expertises en laboratoriumdiensten in de Antwerpse en Gentse haven. Ook zijn wij ISO-9001 gecertificeerd en ISO 17025 geaccrediteerd voor analyses en controles als onafhankelijke partij. Als deel van Bureau Veritas streven wij naar een feilloze dienstverlening naar onze klanten toe, en is continu verbeteren meer dan een begrip alleen.
 

Functieomschrijving
 

Bureau Veritas zoekt een gepassioneerde 
Surveyor Liquid Cargo 
 

Kerntaken
 
 

• Zelfstandig inspectieopdrachten uitvoeren in full continu systeem 

• Begeleiden van los- en laadoperaties bij raffinaderijen en opslagterminals 

• Hoeveelheidsbepalingen en staalnames uitvoeren 

• Nauwkeurige rapportage aan shiftsupervisor  

Profiel
 

Vereiste competenties
 
 

• ✓ Uitdagingen omarmen 

• ✓ Werken op hoogte 

• ✓ Fysiek werk in alle weersomstandigheden schrikt je niet af 

• ✓ Bereid in shiften te werken 

• ✓ Hoge mate van nauwkeurigheid 

• ✓ Goede kennis Engels 

• ✓ Geldig rijbewijs 

• ✓ Veiligheids bewustzijn 

• ✓ Zelfstandige werkhouding  

Ons Aanbod
 
 

•  Moderne, dynamische werkomgeving en  Competitief loonpakket 

• Salaris: 2966,08 Euro bruto per maand voor een voltijdse tewerkstelling 

•  Bedrijfswagen na 6 maanden en positieve evaluatie 

• ️ Maaltijdcheques en  Ecocheques 

•  Groeps- en hospitalisatieverzekering  

***
 

Vacancy: Surveyor Liquid Cargo Antwerp and Ghent
 

Bureau Veritas Commodities is a major player in the field of audits of logistics operations, expertise and laboratory services in the ports of Antwerp and Ghent. We are also ISO-9001 certified and ISO 17025 accredited for analyses and inspections as an independent party. As part of Bureau Veritas, we strive to provide a flawless service to our clients, and continuous improvement is more than just a concept.
 

Job description
 

Bureau Veritas is looking for a passionate 
Surveyor Liquid Cargo 
 

Core tasks
 
 

• Independently carry out inspection assignments in a full continuous system 

• Supervising unloading and loading operations at refineries 

• Perform quantity determination and sampling 

• Accurate reporting to shift supervisor  

Profile
 

Required competencies
 
 

• ✓ Embracing challenges 

• ✓ High level of accuracy 

• ✓ Flawless Dutch and English communication 

• ✓ Valid driver's license 

• ✓ Safety and procedural awareness 

• ✓ Independent work attitude  

Our offer
 

Benefits
 
 

•  Modern, dynamic working environment 

•  Competitive salary package 

• Salary : 2966,08 Euro gross per month for full-time employment 

•  Company car after 6 months and positive evaluation 

• ️ Meal vouchers 

•  Eco vouchers 

•  Group and hospitalisation insurance  

 

Vereiste competenties
 
 

• ✓ Uitdagingen omarmen 

• ✓ Werken op hoogte 

• ✓ Fysiek werk in alle weersomstandigheden schrikt je niet af 

• ✓ Bereid in shiften te werken 

• ✓ Hoge mate van nauwkeurigheid 

• ✓ Goede kennis Engels 

• ✓ Geldig rijbewijs 

• ✓ Veiligheids bewustzijn 

• ✓ Zelfstandige werkhouding
